name: legacy-relight
description: Relight of a compiled legacy map (tools/quality/legacy_bsp_relight.py): the gi-fixture light paths (64 diffuse bounces, no clamping) baked on the GPU at 4096 samples into a 4096 atlas with separated direct and indirect LMAP v2 layers (the total is their sum), denoised per chart as a finishing step; the noise gate requires the halves' residual difference after that denoise to stay under 15% at the 99th percentile (testchmb_a_00 at 2048 texels measured 28% at 256 samples and 17% at 1024; raw noise falls as 1 / sqrt(samples)), a PRBV probe volume at 2 m (a whole Portal map spans about 100 x 60 x 40 m), a radiosity transfer at 1 m patches and an SDFV at 0.4 m voxels for the SDF-traced producer. The map's nodraw brush sides (relight_occluder) occlude in every bake but get no atlas space and are left out of the world mesh. No reflection probe, directional page or pipeline reference render; the SDFV's light cells are 2 m, culled by range (0.001), side and the map's PVS.
